name: Regulatory-shock de-risk — crackdown spike x momentum rollover (perp short)
rationale: EVENT-STUDY / REGIME, SHORT — the active de-risking complement of reg-risk-derisk-momentum (which goes LONG when reg risk is LOW). reg_risk_crypto is an LLM-as-judge [0,1] crackdown-pressure index; a SPIKE marks rising regulatory risk (enforcement, bans, restrictive rulings) that historically precedes crypto de-risking as institutions and retail reduce exposure ahead of the overhang. This shorts the de-risk: enter short when reg_risk_crypto crosses UP through a fitted crackdown level (fresh regulatory shock) AND price momentum has rolled over (confirming the market is already pricing the overhang, not ignoring it); stop ABOVE, take-profit BELOW; exit when reg risk subsides through a low level (overhang cleared). Mechanism uses the VELOCITY (cross_up = a fresh spike) plus price confirmation, distinct from reg-risk-derisk-momentum (reg_risk LEVEL low + momentum LONG). Disconfirmer 1: drop the reg-risk arm — if bare momentum-rollover shorting matches the deflated Sharpe, the regulatory shock adds nothing. Disconfirmer 2: regulatory spikes are sometimes bought (sell-the-rumor-buy-the-news); if requiring the spike makes the edge WORSE, the overhang is already priced and the event-study sign is wrong. Disconfirmer 3 (PIT/cost): reg_risk_crypto is PIT at evidence-availability; thin sample (LLM index, ~5 prod points so far) means effective-N may be below the gate floor — the gate's min-trades will catch it. perp short pays/earns funding; net of ~20bps+. tier1 reg_risk_crypto + tier0 ret_Nd, thin-but-fresh prod data — low-confidence until OOS; SHORT = perp.
catalyst: reg_risk_crypto crosses up into a crackdown spike WHILE price momentum rolls over — active regulatory de-risking, shorted on perp
